## Test Product for Acceptability: Lot Acceptance Sampling {#sec-pmc-2}

[**Contents of section 2**]{#sec-pmc-2-contents}

This section describes how to make decisions on a lot-by-lot basis whether to accept a lot as likely to meet requirements or reject the lot as likely to have too many defective units.

This section consists of the following topics.

1. [What is Acceptance Sampling?](#sec-pmc-21)
2. [What kinds of Lot Acceptance Sampling Plans (LASPs) are there?](#sec-pmc-22)
3. [How do you Choose a Single Sampling Plan?](#sec-pmc-23)
   1. [Choosing a Sampling Plan: MIL Standard 105D](#sec-pmc-231)
   2. [Choosing a Sampling Plan with a given OC Curve](#sec-pmc-232)
4. [What is Double Sampling?](#sec-pmc-24)
5. [What is Multiple Sampling?](#sec-pmc-25)
6. [What is a Sequential Sampling Plan?](#sec-pmc-26)
7. [What is Skip Lot Sampling?](#sec-pmc-27)
